70491:1286.name: Footer
70491:1286.description: Desktop footer, 1200 wide: three feature medallions with a newsletter signup, the brand band with contact details, and four link columns with social and wallet chips. Drop as the last child of the screen with FILL width and HUG height. On screens with a modal scrim the footer must stay BELOW the scrim in paint order. Content is identical on every screen; no per-instance overrides expected.

70504:3190.name: Checkout Page
70504:3190.description: Full checkout page content: header, breadcrumb and wallet payment form. Shared by the payment screen and the order-confirmation screen behind its modal. Dependency: its Arrow-Down instances resolve to the local main component 9:1589, which is parented inside the "ENS Input" frame on the collector profile screen — deleting or detaching that frame orphans them.

70504:3297.name: Marketplace Page
70504:3297.description: Full marketplace home page content shown behind the sign-in and sign-up modals: banner, sort row, product grid and filters panel. Its header is an instance of Header With Divider. Known unfixed defects frozen here: an orphan duplicate price label "2.29 ETH" overlapping a card, and a square-cornered RARO chip overhanging a rounded card corner — fixing either one here now updates both auth screens at once.

70504:2994.name: Mobile Social Block
70504:2994.description: Mobile social sign-in block: labelled divider plus Google and Facebook buttons. Desktop variants differ in spacing and are intentionally not instances of this.

70548:1724.name: Text/Primary
70548:1724.description: Slightly warmer cream than Color/Foreground, kept for the headings carried over from the retired legacy palette.
